fetched_title: The Ringelmann Effect in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Scaling Law for Effective Team Size
summary: Derives an effective-team-size scaling law R(N)=N_eff/N with a regime exponent and tests it across 44 model-task-condition cells, including peer debate, self-correction and a random-noise placebo. It measures answer diversity and correctness redundancy, not judges selecting wrong candidates.
